description: This file defines a static class 'DependencyInjection' with an extension method 'AddApplication' for IServiceCollection, used to register application layer services in a .NET project. It sets up MediatR, AutoMapper, FluentValidation validators, and pipeline behaviors.

classes.name: DependencyInjection
classes.description: A static class providing extension method 'AddApplication' to register application services into the DI container.

methods.name: AddApplication
methods.description: An extension method that configures and registers MediatR, AutoMapper, FluentValidation validators, and validation pipeline behaviors into the IServiceCollection.
